title: Touchstone occupancy class codes
text:
Touchstone
 occupancy class codes

The primary codes for occupancy classes define the type of activity carried out in the
 risks included in a record. 
Touchstone
 support for
 occupancy classes varies by country/region. Use the best possible occupancy class code from
 the appropriate list of occupancy class codes for a particular country or region.

The related information links provide information about the 
Touchstone
 occupancy class codes and about which
 occupancy class codes are valid for each supported country/region. There is also a link
 to validation information for unknown construction / unknown occupancy combinations.

For information about supported codes and limitations for specific models, refer to the
 model documentation that is available on the 
Client Portal
.
